name: Cyprus
title: Herodian Queen, wife of Agrippa I
summary: Cyprus was the wife of Herod Agrippa I and mother to several notable figures in the Herodian family, including Drusilla and Berenice. She belonged to the Herodian dynasty that played a role in the narratives of the New Testament.

keyEvents.title: Part of the Herodian family
keyEvents.description: As the wife of Agrippa I, Cyprus was the mother of Drusilla and Berenice, both of whom are mentioned in Acts.
